dedupe_keys.name: annual water production by saline water conversion corporation swcc

description: Annual Water Production by Saline Water Conversion Corporation SWCC is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset provides annual statistics on the volume of desalinated water produced by the Saline Water Conversion Corporation (SWCC) in Saudi Arabia. As the world's largest producer of desalinated water, SWCC's production figures can inform assessments of Saudi Arabia's water security, resource management, and economic development. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Water & Agriculture. Its keywords are Production. The portal shows 2015-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
